messages.content: Who did the Scarecrow say conquered him after the Wizard left?
General Jinjur.
Where did the Wizard keep his big silver watch?
In his vest pocket.
What time did the Wizard read on his watch in the cave?
Half-past three.
What was the floor like in the cave with the pairs of yellow lights?
Smooth and level.
How often did the college boys yell as they marched?
Every other step.
What did the Wizard promise to cancel so he could stay in Oz?
His engagements abroad.
Where did Billina's tale of her adventures with the Nome King take place?
The Land of Ev.
Where did Dorothy threaten to send Eureka if she would not come out?
The Country of the Gurgles.
Where did Eureka hide while Ozma was dressing?
Under a chair.
Who told stories to the guests on the last evening in Oz?
The Scarecrow.
How many wooden wings were beside them on the platform after Zeb climbed up?
Eight wooden wings.
What color was the sunlight on the Wizard's face when Dorothy corrected him?
Violet.
Why did Eureka think the fish had no bones?
Nothing scratched her throat.
Who did the Scarecrow live with after Ozma defeated Jinjur?
Nick Chopper.
